Ensure you sign in when attending

Based on personal experience. Unless you our happy to take medication for everything, I wouldn't suggest use this practice.

Time management is poor if you have commitments (child care or elderly parent that require supervision) allow an hour to be seen
Doctors seem nonchalant and follow a script instead of helping the specific patient needs. (My Personal experience only, you're experience may differ)

The practice offers no easily accessible ways of recorded communication, everything is verbal which leads me to believe there is little accountability for the doctors and staff that work here

Overall disappointed with the service that they provide as the majority of people only ever attend when absolutely necessary. The experience needs to be improved for the patients

Waiting times need to be updated more regularly to give people the option of leaving or rebooking if the practice is behind on appointments, this would drastically improve the  trust between the public and the staff as time is a valuable asset.

Leaving women who rely on child care or elderly patients that rely on transport waiting without updates shows a lack of care.

There needs to be a email system in place so that the average person can create personal logs and ensure practices are being followed correctly

Whether this being, emailing there doctor for advice or reading through the doctors notes at a later date. Accessibility needs to improve.

Hope this helps the practice understand a few issue members of public are having and make changes that help the community that there apart
